preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 2 and 105, inclusive.
The capital city s is a valid city number between 1 and n, inclusive.
The number of roads m is between 1 and 105, inclusive.
Each road connects two different cities vi and ui, where vi and ui are between 1 and n, inclusive.
No road connects a city to itself.
The length of each road wi is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
The distance l from the capital to the missile silos is between 0 and 109, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer.
The number of missile silos located in Berland is non-negative.

postconditions.expression: output == count(silo for silo in cities if shortest_distance(silo, s) == l)
postconditions.description: The output is the count of cities and points on roads where the shortest distance to the capital is exactly l.
